Class VehicleList

java.lang.Object
util.List<Vehicle>
parking.VehicleList
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<Vehicle>
public class VehicleList extends List<Vehicle>
VehicleList class that holds the registered vehicles. It extends the generic List class with the operations specific to a list of vehicles.
